category_objective: Random data cannot be losslessly compressed below its information content in expectation. This category therefore targets a complete-artifact size tie with the equally framed store fallback, materially lower cost than attempting strong compression, and exact bounded behavior rather than an impossible five-percent ratio win.
claim_ceiling: Frozen development protocol only. No corpus acquisition, measurement, validation, private-holdout, independent-reproduction, product-completion, or state-of-the-art result exists yet.

development_families.generation: Counter-mode 1 MiB blocks: SHAKE256(domain || 0x00 || item_id || uint64_le(block_index)).digest(block_length), with domain compression-lab/incompressible-development/v1 and exact predeclared sizes

Deterministic 64 MiB items containing random, zero, repeated-text, and uint32-counter regions in every first/middle/last and alternating 1 MiB ordering needed to defeat prefix-only, suffix-only, and three-point sampling assumptions
SHAKE-256 bytes with syntactically plausible gzip, ZIP, PNG, JPEG, PDF, Zstandard, XZ, and 7-Zip prefixes but no valid matching container

Deterministically encode the byte-verified CPython 3.14.6 and Rust 1.97.1 source bundles with each frozen precompression codec; preserve the original provenance and do not redistribute source payloads in benchmark receipts

information_theoretic_boundary.reason: A universal lossless codec cannot make every high-entropy string smaller; pigeonhole counting requires some inputs to expand. Success is a Pareto-safe store decision, not a fabricated compression win.

name: incompressible-precompressed-product-gates-v1

zip-deflate-9.policy: One input.bin member; raw DEFLATE level 9; DOS timestamp 1980-01-01T00:00:00; create_system 0; no extra fields, comment, path, permissions, or source metadata.

private_holdout_policy.requirements: An independent holder selects licensed real-world precompressed media/archive families plus a secret high-entropy generator seed after the candidate and all gates are frozen. The unchanged candidate runs exactly once, and only aggregate receipts and redistributable evidence are returned.
private_holdout_policy.status: policy frozen; corpus unselected and inaccessible

public_validation_policy.requirements: After candidate freeze, select future official source-release and Wikimedia publisher artifacts not used anywhere in development; derive high-entropy seeds from their publisher digests, create the same precompression-format matrix, and score exactly once without tuning.
public_validation_policy.status: policy frozen; corpus unopened and unselected

split_policy.development: Only the five declared generated or already-acquired licensed lineages may influence implementation or thresholds.
split_policy.private_holdout: External real-world formats and a secret seed; inaccessible to developers until the unchanged one-shot score.
split_policy.public_validation: Future lineage-disjoint publisher artifacts that do not exist in the development corpus; unopened until candidate freeze.
